title: VCF Automation blueprint validate-then-create REST subset
sourceNotice: This local contract was derived from authoritative Broadcom xAPIs reference documentation because VCF Automation has no published specification in vmware/vcf-api-specs. It is a reference-documentation contract, not a published specification.
specificationRepositoryContext: The Apache-2.0 vmware/vcf-api-specs repository does not publish a VCF Automation specification.

transport.scheme: https on a live appliance; loopback http in the protected verifier

clientSurface.method: BlueprintLink validateAndCreate(BlueprintDraft draft) throws java.io.IOException, InterruptedException, ValidationException

nestedTypes.BlueprintDraft: public record BlueprintDraft(String name, String content, String projectId, String description, String apiVersion)
nestedTypes.BlueprintLink: public record BlueprintLink(String id, String selfLink)
nestedTypes.ValidationException: public static final checked exception containing the rejected validation response

requestBody.omissionRule: Fields not set by BlueprintDraft are absent; the client does not synthesize blueprintId, blueprintVersion, inputs, or empty values.
Null optional fields are absent. Response-only and content-source fields are never sent by this client.

workflowInvariant: createBlueprint is called if and only if validateBlueprint returned HTTP 200, contained a boolean valid member, and that member was true. Any other precheck outcome stops the workflow without a mutating request.

protectedWireExample.note: The protected verifier compares raw paths, raw query presence, methods, required headers, JSON field spelling, and the documented member order while allowing insignificant JSON whitespace.
